query: Looking for unscented soy candle, no additives, safe for sensitive sinuses, 16oz jar.

products.title: Unscented Pure Soy Candle
products.description: An unscented candle designed for occasions where fragrance is not desired, such as while cooking or when diffusing oils. These handmade candles are poured in small batches using 100% pure American-made soy wax and clean-burning cotton wicks, providing a cozy ambiance without any added scent. They are vegan, cruelty-free, and phthalate-free.

products.title: Sea Salt Surf Soy Candle
products.description: Experience the essence of a crisp morning on the beach with our Sea Salt Surf Soy Candle. This fresh and alluring scent features notes of sea salt kissing the wind, followed by flowery jasmine and sweet cream, all grounded by a base of beachy driftwood. Hand-poured with 100% U.S.-grown soybean wax, this candle provides an even, clean burn that brings the ocean breeze into your home.
key_features: Cotton core wicks for a clean burn
Scent Profile: Wood, Cream, and Jasmine

products.title: Black Currant Soy Candle
products.description: A clean, minimal soy candle featuring a rich black currant fragrance with fruity, floral, and earthy notes. Presented in a clear glass jar with a reusable acacia wood lid, available in 3.5 oz and 12.3 oz sizes. The 12.3 oz version features three wicks for an even burn and longer life. Packaging emphasizes plastic-free and upcycle-ready design; jar can be repurposed after use. Suitable for home ambiance and gifting.
key_features: Rich black currant scent with fruity, floral, and earthy notes
Plastic-free glass jar with reusable acacia wood lid
Three wicks in the 12.3 oz size for longer, more even burn
Repurpose the glass jar after wax is gone
Soy wax, cotton wicks, lead-free and vegan-friendly
Recyclable glass jar with lid for upcycling
Three wicks in the largest size for a longer, more even burn
Vessel is reusable after candle is finished

products.title: The Studio Candle
products.description: The Studio Candle is a sustainable, small-batch soy wax candle from Wax Buffalo. Created using remnants from pouring parties, test scents, and returned jars, this unique candle is designed to capture the essence of walking into a Wax Buffalo studio. It is handcrafted using 100% American-made soy wax, phthalate-free fragrances, and clean-burning cotton wicks, embodying a commitment to reuse, reduce, and recycle.
key_features: Sustainable design using repurposed wax and jars

products.title: Soy Candle
products.description: Transport yourself to a cozy corner of your local cafe with the Coffee Shop soy candle. This inviting scent features top notes of coffee, sweet cream, and coffee in the middle, grounded by a warm base of vanilla and chocolate. Hand-poured in small batches in St. Augustine, FL, this 8 oz candle is crafted from natural soy wax with organic cotton wicks, ensuring a clean, vegan, and phthalate-free burn for approximately 45 hours.
key_features: Scent notes: Coffee, Sweet Cream, Vanilla, and Chocolate

products.title: Soy Candle
products.description: A graceful floral soy candle that captures the essence of a flower stand at golden hour. This hand-poured candle blends delicate peony and crisp green leaves with warm musk to create a soft, sunlit aroma. Made with 100% U.S.-grown soybean wax, it is vegan, gluten-free, paraben-free, and phthalate-free.
key_features: Scent notes of Peony, Green Leaves, and Musk

products.title: Soy Candle
products.description: Capture the vibrant essence of Los Angeles with this hand-poured soy candle. Featuring a complex fragrance blend of redwood, lime, jasmine, and yarrow, this candle evokes images of canyon drives and city sunsets. It is housed in an amber jar with a stylish brass lid and finished with a kraft label. Perfect for setting a magical ambiance on any surface.
key_features: Made with 100% domestically grown soy wax
Fragrance notes: redwood, lime, jasmine, and yarrow
Hand-poured in amber jar with brass lid and kraft label

products.title: Tin Candle
products.description: A 16 oz artisan soy candle contained in a metal tin with a handcrafted label, featuring a coffee scent. Hand poured in Burbank, CA, with an approximate burn time of 80 hours. Made in USA. Unique handmade packaging.
